Name: Big Crop Bonus
Author: Tocseoj
Description:
If Giant cauliflower, melon, and pumpkin, etc. are present, then give a +10% of selling price for the crop and their related products. This
stacks!
Percentage can be edited in config.json (0.1 is 10% per, 1.5 is 150% per, etc.)
Supports custom giant crops from other mods! (Tested with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5221]https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5221[/url])
Won't work in multiplayer with split wallets... yet! Still learning how, and will update as soon as I can!

v0.1.2 - Tweaked test mode info
v0.1.1 - Updated .zip to release build
v0.1.0 - Initial release
